ROOKIE ORIENTATION

THEY FALL.
YOU FIGHT BACK.

  1. Choose Type or Speak and a practice target, then press Start. Your choices are remembered; instructions are optional. Phones and tablets get compact game keys.
  2. With a physical keyboard, type anywhere inside the game tab. Unmatched entries clear after 0.8 seconds of inactivity; incomplete valid answers stay. Type number answers as digits. For vocabulary, solve the clue; listed alternative answers count too. In Speak mode, say the displayed number, letter name or word. IPA cards ask for the whole word.
  3. Start with two hearts. Ghosts take one answer. Bats are fast and fly a winding path, Stone Golems take three answers, Vampires weave and take two, and Ember Sprites speed up as they fall. Every surviving hit reveals a new question. Life Spirits give one heart, up to five. Defeated monsters sometimes drop a Frost Orb (slows the swarm for five seconds) or an Ember Orb (burns every monster three times). The swarm grows by one monster each wave, and every match gets a different backdrop and starting track.
  4. A boss arrives every fourth wave: the Ink Colossus (12 answers), the Night Harpy (7, fast), the Bone Weaver (10, speeds up when nearly beaten) and the Deep Kraken (15, hurries the swarm). Each has its own theme music. Bosses never hold up the other monsters, and fast monsters swerve lanes to pass slow ones. On a short phone screen, monsters get up to 35% more travel time, and adding Inkfang to your Home Screen removes the browser bars for a taller arena. Each answer-earned kill gives one mana, up to ten. Spend it on Slowfield (3), Frostlock (4), Twin Strike (5) or Chain Lightning (6), or save ten for Inkstorm. Slow lasts seven seconds, freeze lasts four seconds, and Twin / Chain boost your next four correct answers. Chain strikes one nearby monster; it does not trigger itself again. Tap Inkstorm (or press Space on a physical keyboard) to clear ordinary monsters and remove half of a boss’s HP. Spell kills do not recharge mana.
  5. Runs last 2 minutes, 5 minutes, or until your hearts run out. Question levels rise every two waves, within your chosen ceiling. Speak mode keeps its gentler pace and microphone grace period.

Speech depends on your browser’s recognition service and connection; it checks recognized words, not phoneme accuracy. No audio is saved by Inkfang. Best scores and custom questions stay on this browser.
